# Irha Apparels

> B2B custom apparel manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan for brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers and private-label buyers.

Irha Apparels provides OEM, ODM and private-label apparel programs. The public website is organized around two production hubs: Bavarian & Leather, and Sportswear, Streetwear & Leisure. Product feasibility, materials, construction, sampling, MOQ, pricing, production timing, shipping and documentation are confirmed after the buyer's requirements are reviewed.

The website does not publish fixed commercial commitments or unverified certification claims. Buyers may request a live factory view by video call during requirement discussion.

## Primary public pages

- [Home](https://irhaapparels.com/): Current B2B manufacturing overview and main buyer actions.
- [Collections](https://irhaapparels.com/products): Published apparel categories and product programs.
- [Catalogue](https://irhaapparels.com/catalogue): Buyer-friendly catalogue groups.
- [Manufacturing](https://irhaapparels.com/manufacturing): Requirement-led manufacturing workflow.
- [Buyer Trust](https://irhaapparels.com/buyer-trust): Verification, communication and buyer confidence information.
- [Factory Video Call](https://irhaapparels.com/factory-video-call): Live factory-view request information.
- [Inquiry](https://irhaapparels.com/inquiry): Quotes, samples, catalogue requests, references and meeting requests.
- [Contact](https://irhaapparels.com/contact): Official email and WhatsApp contact options.

## Two production hubs

- Bavarian & Leather: Trachten wear, Lederhosen, Dirndl programs and premium leather apparel.
- Sportswear, Streetwear & Leisure: Teamwear, activewear, heavyweight streetwear, leisurewear and nightwear.
